warning: Venue rules change every cycle. These are dated snapshots. Re-read the live call for papers before signing off on compliance - see VERIFY.md.

required_artifacts.name: NeurIPS Paper Checklist
required_artifacts.placement: after references and after any supplemental material

ai_policy.disclosure: required for methodologically significant or non-standard use of LLMs/agents
notes: The Position Paper Track has a different LLM policy from the main program.

required_sections.name: Impact statement
required_sections.placement: separate section at end, with acknowledgements, before references
required_sections.content: potential broader impact including ethical aspects and future societal consequences

ai_policy.disclosure: expected; reviewers must declare their LLM-use policy stance
notes: In the 2026 cycle ICML desk-rejected 497 submissions over LLM review-policy violations by reciprocal reviewers.

artifact_policy.code: encouraged, must be anonymized or submitted directly; considered in decisions

length.notes: 9 pages at submission; raised to 10 for the discussion/rebuttal phase and camera ready.

ai_policy.disclosure: required for any significant LLM use in research ideation or writing
ai_policy.enforcement: reviewers who find undisclosed LLM use notify the area chair; LLM-generated papers have been desk rejected
ai_policy.reviewer_disclosure: mandatory, with a field on the review form

dual_submission.consequence: rejection, and reported to the other venue

notes: CVPR's LLM policy has changed between cycles - re-verify before submitting.

acl-arr.name: ACL Rolling Review (ACL / EMNLP / NAACL / EACL)

ai_policy.disclosure: required - AI tool use for writing or coding must be disclosed in the Responsible NLP checklist

aaai.name: AAAI

required_artifacts.name: AAAI Reproducibility Checklist
required_artifacts.placement: in the PDF after the references

submission_process.note: A separate abstract submission precedes the full paper deadline by about a week. Missing the abstract deadline forfeits the submission.

desk_reject_triggers: no abstract submitted by the abstract deadline

tmlr.name: Transactions on Machine Learning Research

length.notes: No page limit. Length must still be justified by content.

tmlr.anonymity: single-blind-ish (authors may be revealed; check current policy)
acceptance_criteria: Are the claims supported by accurate and convincing evidence? (the primary criterion)
Would some individuals in TMLR's audience be interested in the findings?
notes: TMLR explicitly does NOT require novelty or broad significance - a well-evidenced negative or incremental result is acceptable.
Clear writing is an explicit part of the acceptance criteria.
Any gap between claims and evidence must be closed by adding evidence or by weakening the claim, even if that reduces the work's apparent impact.

tpami.name: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

length.notes: Roughly 14 double-column pages for a Regular Paper including references and biographies; mandatory overlength charges apply beyond the chargeable limit, assessed after final layout. Verify current figures with the journal.

notes: Journal review expects substantially more depth than a conference paper - fuller related work, more thorough experiments, and often a theoretical treatment.
Extensions of a prior conference paper must state the delta explicitly and typically need ~30% new material. Verify the current threshold.

nature.name: Nature (Article)

length.notes: ~2500 words total (summary paragraph plus body) for a 6-page Article with 4 modest display items; ~4300 words for an 8-page Article with 5-6 display items.

abstract.name: summary paragraph
constraints: avoid numbers, abbreviations, acronyms and measurements unless essential

required_artifacts.name: Reporting summary
required_artifacts.applies_to: life sciences and behavioural & social sciences research

notes: Initial submissions are format-flexible - style and length will not, within reason, influence consideration. Format strictly at revision.
Each Nature-family journal differs; check the specific journal's guide.

technology-in-society.name: Technology in Society (Elsevier), Review article

length.notes: No word or page limit found for review articles.

abstract.name: abstract
constraints: avoid references; if essential cite author(s) and year(s)

technology-in-society.anonymity: double-anonymized: title page (with author details) and anonymized manuscript as separate files

required_sections.name: Declaration of generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the writing process

technology-in-society.scope: Technological change at the intersection of social, economic, business and digital transformation; how technologies influence socio-cultural structures, economic systems, governance and organisational practice.
notes: Verified 2026-10-02 from search-engine extracts of the official Guide for Authors; the guide itself returned HTTP 403 to automated access, so re-read it live before submission (venues/VERIFY.md).

Emphasis set to contribution, related_work and writing_clarity because the journal judges papers on their technology-society contribution, their place in that literature, and clarity for an interdisciplinary readership.
